answer: NovaOps does not allow employees to use a personal laptop for work, except for a five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device. IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. Personal laptops are otherwise prohibited for work use according to the equipment policy effective 2026-06-01​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​.

IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for the five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device. You cannot just go ahead without IT approval and logging​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​.
The Equipment Policy is owned by IT, as stated at the top of the policy document effective 2026-06-01​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § (whole document)]​.
